text: I think I can make an exception to recommend this recipe to you, despite the garlic being a bit of a concern. However, I've checked the ingredient list and it seems that garlic is the primary flavor component, but it's not the only one. The parmesan cheese and monterey jack cheese will likely take center stage, and the garlic will just add a subtle depth to the flavor. Since you don't have any dietary restrictions, I think you'll be able to enjoy this recipe without any issues.
